gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
While carrying a lit sapphire lantern, use a games necklace to teleport to the Tears of Guthix cavern (option 7). Then, use the "travel into cavern" option on a nearby light creature, which brings you to the Guthixian temple. Head south and climb up the eastern wall twice, then climb through the skull to enter to the Guthixian temple. In the next intersection, continue heading straight down, towards the temple.

Alternatively, a Sixth-Age circuit can be used to teleport directly into the temple, which saves an inventory space as you do not need a lantern to lure a light creature.

A Light Creature can be interacted with to teleport directly to the crossroads leading to the tormented demons, take the southern path.

You can also use the quest cape or master quest cape (option 1) to teleport directly to the Guthixian temple.

If you have access to the Max Guild, you can attune the boss portal to Tormented Demons.
